items.title: How much does caching alone move the cost-per-order needle?
items.description: GreenCart's cost per order was $0.11 with no caching at all — every checkout request hit the database. Drag the cache hit ratio up and watch cost per order fall, holding compute cost and per-miss database cost fixed. This is the single lever from L1's 'caching and right-sizing' pair, isolated.
items.compute: const computeCostPerRequest = 0.034; const costPerOrder = computeCostPerRequest + (1 - params.cacheHitRatio) * params.dbCostPerRequest; return { costPerOrder };

items.title: At what utilization does reserving capacity actually save money?
items.description: Reserved capacity is cheaper per hour, but it's paid whether or not it's used — on-demand only charges for hours actually run. Drag utilization (how much of the month the instance would run) and see the monthly savings from reserving flip from negative (reserving loses money) to positive (reserving wins) as it crosses the break-even point.

params.name: utilizationPercent
params.label: Utilization (% of the month's hours running)

items.compute: const hoursInMonth = 730; const onDemandMonthlyCost = params.onDemandRatePerHour * hoursInMonth * (params.utilizationPercent / 100); const reservedMonthlyCost = params.reservedRatePerHour * hoursInMonth; const monthlySavingsFromReserving = onDemandMonthlyCost - reservedMonthlyCost; return { monthlySavingsFromReserving };

outputs.label: Monthly savings from reserving (negative = reserving loses money)

items.title: Play with the actual computeMonthlyCost model from this level's code
items.description: This reproduces the computeMonthlyCost formula from the code above, with GreenCart's real after-redesign numbers as defaults: a $3,200/month reserved baseline covering 14M requests, an 80% cache hit ratio, and 20M orders/month. Drag order volume, cache hit ratio, and how much reserved capacity is provisioned to see cost per request respond — including what happens when volume outgrows the reserved baseline.
items.compute: const onDemandCostPerRequest = 0.00034; const dbCostPerUncachedRequest = 0.00026; const reservedMonthlyCost = 3200; const uncachedRequests = Math.round(params.requestsPerMonth * (1 - params.cacheHitRatio)); const requestsBeyondReservedCapacity = Math.max(0, params.requestsPerMonth - params.reservedCapacityRequestsPerMonth); const totalCost = reservedMonthlyCost + requestsBeyondReservedCapacity * onDemandCostPerRequest + uncachedRequests * dbCostPerUncachedRequest; const costPerRequest = totalCost / params.requestsPerMonth; return { costPerRequest };
